svg.text: One cell per observed behavior. Hover a cell for its name. Green replicated, olive partial, grey not yet.
Visual = layout, color, type and motion; behavior = interactions and data. 0-100, from REA captures. Grey rows have not been compared yet.
104 px bar, nav positions, active underline and top-row links measured. Install button replaced by Uplo…
Hero, 840+360 carousel with peeking slides, section order and spacing match. Art is procedural; fewer s…
Panel structure, headings, tiles, pills, expand control and animation match. Contents are reSteam’s own…
Backdrop, banner, breadcrumb, buy box, rails match. No trailers, DLC or system requirements.
Rows, filter panels, chips and sort match; filters are fewer than the real ~40.
Compared with an empty cart only; payment step is play money.
Header and empty state matched; populated rows not compared.
940 px column, panels and tabs match; no workshop, screenshots or broadcasts.
Only the home banner was compared; the queue page is modelled on its behavior.
Form, QR sign-in handshake and recovery flow studied; visual treatment is approximate.
Four-column layout matched; legal pages do not exist.
Throbber, carousel fades, hover lifts and menu timings copied from the real CSS values.
12 of about 29 languages, chrome strings only; real store translates every page.
Built from the earlier client study; not yet compared with the web hub.
Not yet compared with the web account pages.
The real library lives in the desktop client; modelled on the earlier client study.
Client-only feature, here backed by real file downloads for uploaded builds.
98 endpoints across 5 areas, 28 database tables, plus one Durable Object per user for WebSocket push. Green = exercised by an e2e check.

Not yet covered by a check: GET /auth/me, DELETE /games/:id/review, POST /reviews/:id/report, GET /games/:id/posts, POST /posts/:id/vote, DELETE /replies/:id, POST /replies/:id/report, GET /community/feed, GET /community/hubs and 21 more
12 languages × 113 strings, all complete. But only 18% of on-screen text goes through the translator (104 call sites vs about 465 hard-coded labels).

Languages: Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish, Turkish. Strings missing for the other ~17 languages the real store offers.
Missing or partial behaviors, in the order they matter most.
What was actually captured from the real store, so every score above can be traced.
store home, signed out → 138 requests; saledata, userdata, GetItems batch API identified
real stylesheets via REA asset URLs
14 store stylesheets → loading throbber, carousel, hover and menu timings extracted
home, game, search, community at 1400 px → layout widths, heights and colors measured against ours
six store menus → panel structure, headings, links and animation captured
cart, wishlist, language pulldown → layouts and empty states captured; 29-language list read
17 open fonts vs real nav text → Albert Sans matched real widths at native size (scale 0.99 to 1.00)
library, friends, downloads, settings → client behaviors recorded in docs/rea-findings.md
